A [[human]] individual served in the [[Imperial Military]] as an '''aide''' to [[Lieutenant]] [[Pol Treidum]]<ref name="Junior Novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]]</ref> aboard a [[Control Room 327|command office]] that overlooked [[Docking Bay 327]] during an attempt to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Princess]] of [[Alderaan]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. During the rescue attempt, the [[aide]] was [[Death|killed]] by a [[blaster]] shot from [[Han Solo]] disguised as a [[stormtrooper]] after his companion, the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], incapacitated Lieutenant Treidum. The aide was equipped with a [[Color|black]] [[Imperial military uniforms|military uniform]], a [[holster]] and [[blaster pistol]], a [[Imperial kepi|kepi]], and a Imperial [[rank insignia plaque]] with two red tiles.<ref name="Episode IV" />

{{Char-stub}}
